annotations.title: Count the values of one tag on an issue

description: How often each value of one tag or facet appears on one issue in the last 30 days. Use it to see where an issue concentrates: which release, route, device, logger or person. Leave out key to list the keys there are.

key.description: A facet (release, route, environment, level, device, os_version, handled, mechanism, logger, user) or any tag name
